question: We have seven trade offers pending, all proposed by us and all sending Anthony Black; only one can execute, and all expire on 4 Nov between 05:49 and 06:33 UTC. Which one should we keep pending (withdrawing the other six), or should we withdraw all seven? (1) Jabari Smith Jr. (HOU) from Team Nic Kerr for Black + VanVleet. (2) James Harden (CLE) from Team Nic Kerr for Black. (3) Jalen Brunson (NY) from Melbourne poopoo for Black + VanVleet + Kawhi Leonard. (4) Amen Thompson (HOU) from Matt Wright's Foxies for VanVleet + Black. (5) Jaylen Brown (PHI) from Snow Time Lakers for VanVleet + Black. (6) Devin Booker (PHX) from Snow Time Lakers for Black + VanVleet. (7) Dyson Daniels (ATL) from Snow Time Lakers for Black + VanVleet.
constraints: The owner: Fred VanVleet is not a consideration in trades at all; give his value no weight either way.

The owner is high on Anthony Black (kept him on 1 Nov over the council's 19-0 vote to stream his slot): without the 28 Oct blowout he scored 48.5 FP/g, 61.3 FP/36, and his role should grow with Suggs and Banchero out.
